set.body: Outcome: refresh RRG integration against current root/NIfTI changes; complete rank-by-whitening and oracle innovation diagnostic; prototype a targeted joint parametric AR bootstrap in a diagnostic harness; qualify against fresh prespecified simulations. Scope: synthetic fixtures, local isolated candidates and scoped local commits; no merge or push. Preserve root changes. Fixed rank and explicit pointwise intervals only; no automatic nominal T/F or adaptive rank admission. Evidence: independent reference/invariants, prespecified coordinate coverage and failure gates, raw seeded records, source identity, JVM+JS checks. Budget: sequential bounded local JVM studies with 3GiB heap/4 active CPUs, pilot before full simulation. Next: expert design decision and captured integration snapshot.
set.title: Diagnose and qualify voxelwise RRG interval calibration
